solver.kind: blind AI solver (separate agent, answer-free packet, rubric v2)

S009-01.notes: Colon defines the response as neither endorsing nor rejecting: noncommittal = equivocal. Difficulty is vocabulary recognition of 'equivocal'; A/B/D contradict the gloss.

flags: minor: A is the only choice that mentions both the lamplighter's solitude and his effect on the town, so it can be matched by keyword scanning; C is the only real distractor (lamplighter alone at work, but nothing on the town's need for him)
S009-02.notes: 'walks alone' = solitary; 'every window brightens as he goes' = essential to town life. C shows the job but not both traits; B and D omit him.

flags: minor: D is the only hedged choice ('may matter more') against an absolute A ('no effect of any kind'), a familiar test-wise tell
minor: D brings in an outside example (warm late-summer water) the passage never mentions; acceptable because it is offered as 'such as', but it could be tightened
S009-03.notes: The timing mismatch weakens runoff as the main cause, so some other factor likely dominates. A overreaches (the data cannot show zero effect); B and C are unsupported.

S009-04.notes: Text 2: correction was rare, yet grammar was still acquired on schedule, which undercuts the linguist's mechanism. B is the reverse of their view; C and D are unsupported.

S009-05.notes: The sentence needs a finite main verb for the subject 'the city library'; 'holds' (present tense, matching 'today'). The others are nonfinite and leave a fragment.

S009-06.notes: The parenthetical must be closed with ')' and no comma may separate the subject 'designer' from the verb 'was praised'. B adds an illegal comma (a common trap); C mismatches an opening parenthesis with a dash; D leaves the parenthesis unclosed.

S009-07.notes: The program collected more than expected, but much of it could not be recycled: a contrast, so 'However'.

S009-08.notes: Only B both describes the method (three cities, app logging, four weeks) and states a limitation (flat terrain, so results may differ in hilly places). C gives the method only; D gives the limitation only; A reports a finding.

S009-09.notes: Size is given by the dimensions: 40 m tall by 25 m wide.

flags: minor: D 'children's'' is not a form anyone would plausibly choose, so it is a throwaway distractor
S009-10.notes: 'Children' is an irregular plural, so its possessive is 'children's'.
